translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content.text: Bɔ̃rurobɑ bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ Siɔniɔ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ,
kɑ bɛɛ be i sɔ̃ Sɑmɑrin guurɔ kɑ toro sindu.
Mɑ i tɑmɑɑ i sɑ̃ɑ bwese te tɑ kpɑ̃ɑru bon wirugibu.
Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ somiru mɑrɑ bɛɛn min di.
I doo Kɑlinɛɔ i wɑ.
Min di, kpɑ i dɑ Hɑmɑtiɔ wuu bɔkɔ gen mi.
Kpɑ i sɑrɑ i dɑ Gɑtiɔ Filisitibɑn temɔ.
Ben wuu si, su bɛɛ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑn wusu geɑ turɑ?
Ben tem mɛ, mu bɛɛn tem kpɑ̃ɑru turɑ?
Wee i ǹ kĩ wɑhɑlɑn tɔ̃ru tu bɛɛ nɑɑwɑ.
Mɑ i sere tii dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ gɑwemɔ.
Mɑ yɑ bɑndu dii bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ i kpĩ sɑu kpin yee burɑnu sɔɔ, nì bɑ burɑru kuɑ kɑ suunu donnu.
I tii yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu kɑ nɑɑ kpɛmi yi yi gum mɔ gɔsiɑmmɛ gɔ̃sun di i temmɔ.
I mɔrɔkunu soomɔ i womusu mɔ̀ bwisikunu sɑriru sɔɔ.
Mɑ i tɑmɑɑ i nin soberu yɛ̃wɑ nge Dɑfidi.
I tɑm nɔrumɔ kɑ nɔri bɛkɛ.
I tii gum turɑregim sɑwɑmɔ.
Mɑ i ǹ nuki sɑnkire yèn sɔ̃ bɛɛn bweseru tɑ koo kɑm ko.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ koo gbi bu bɛɛ yoru mwɛɛri bu kɑ doonɑ
kpɑ bɛɛn nuku dobun kuuki kɑ bɛɛn tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ dim mu kpe.
Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u bɔ̃ruɑ kɑ win tiin wɑ̃ɑru u nɛɛ,
u ǹ bɛɛ Isirelibɑn tii suɑbu kĩ.
U mɑɑ bɛɛn sinɑ kpɑɑnu tusɑ.
U koo de bu Sɑmɑri mwɑ kɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ye sɔɔ kpuro.

content: Tɔmbu wɔkuru bɑ̀ n tie yɛnu gɑgu sɔɔ, bɑ koo gbiwɑ.

Goo ù n win tɔnun goru suɑ yɛnun di u kɑ yɑrɑ u dɔɔ u dɔ̃ɔ mɛni, u koo wi u wɑ̃ɑ yɛnu sɔɔwɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, goo mɑɑ tie u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wunɛ? Kpɑ yɛ̃ro u nùn wisi u nɛɛ, goo sɑri. Kpɑ wini u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑrio. N ǹ weenɛ su Gusunɔn yĩsiru siɑ sɑɑ yeni sɔɔ kpɑ u sun sĩiremɑ.

content.text: Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u woodɑ yeni wɛ̃ u nɛɛ,
u koo yɛnusu kpuro kɔsukuwɑ, bɑkɑsu kɑ piiminu.
Bɑ rɑ dumi yɑkie kpee sɑɑrɑ wɔllɔ?
Bɑ rɑ kɑ nɛɛ wuku mi?
Adɑmɑ wee bɛɛ i gem gɔsiɑ dɛ̃ɛ.
Mɑ i geɑ gɔsiɑ gɑ̃ɑ sosurɑnu.

content: Bɛɛ i nuku dobu mɔ̀ kɑm sɔɔ, mɑ i gerumɔ i mɔ̀, bɛɛn tiin dɑmɑ i kɑ nɑsɑrɑ wɑ.

Yen sɔ̃nɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u nɛɛ, u koo de bwese tukuru gɑru tu bɛɛ seesi. Kpɑ tu bɛɛ dɑm dɔre sɑɑ Hɑmɑtin duu yerun di sere n kɑ dɑ nim torɑɔ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ gbɑburun berɑ giɑ mi gɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi.
